name: Liberators: Leaders Who Won Independence
description: The fighters, thinkers and statesmen who ended colonial rule, from Washington and Bolivar to Gandhi, Nkrumah and Ho Chi Minh.

checkpoints.name: Revolutions in the Americas
checkpoints.note: Washington, Toussaint Louverture, Tupac Amaru II, Hidalgo, Bolivar and San Martin end European rule across two continents, or challenge it.

checkpoints.name: Nationalists of a new century
checkpoints.note: Rizal and Marti inspire revolts against Spain, Lakshmibai resists the East India Company, and Ireland and Turkey fight for their own states.

checkpoints.name: Asia after the war
checkpoints.note: Gandhi, Nehru and Jinnah win freedom for India and Pakistan, Aung San leads Burma, Sukarno declares Indonesia, and Ho Chi Minh declares Vietnam free.

checkpoints.name: Africa awakes
checkpoints.note: After Nkrumah led Ghana to independence in 1957, Kenyatta, Nyerere and Lumumba led their countries to freedom in the early 1960s, and Mandela later led South Africa from apartheid to democracy.
